IRON YARD -- one-time owner-authorized PUBLIC Roblox update, 12 November 2026.
Release ONLY the existing verified creator-owned PUBLIC IRON YARD experience
through the repository's exact-commit CI-gated guarded Open Cloud workflow.

PR #53 improves final DataStore save reliability during player departure,
late lease acquisition and server shutdown. It counts overlapping acquire,
autosave, departure and detached GUID-owned release operations, and makes
BindToClose continue to wait (up to its existing 26-second limit) for saved XP
even when the last Player has already been removed from active records.
Late release is registered before the originating acquisition completes,
without a zero-outstanding gap. Duplicate shutdown releases are not launched
when PlayerRemoving already owns that final operation.

The source includes earlier monotonic lease and atomic award safeguards.
UserId keys, datastore name/schema v1, XP amounts and gameplay stay unchanged.
Luau regression suites, static contracts, Rojo build on branch and PR, and
merged main CI all succeeded at b651bbb4b0d37d4ea17bffaad08cad9a70e548f0.
Require NEW green CI for the exact release commit, verified creator and PUBLIC
destination, and precisely one publish. This is best-effort finalization;
real Roblox DataStore/reconnect testing remains required.
